description: We are Team ABF, a small team from Dushanbe, Tajikistan. Bunyod is the designer and coder, and Faruch is the speaker who presents our work. We also use Claude, an AI assistant from Anthropic, to help us write code from our instructions. We care about using space data to solve real problems for ordinary people, and our project, ABF Field Shift, is a free web app that helps small farmers see drought, heat, fire and disease risks for their own field using NASA data.
